text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory and I are at a big park a ways from the academy.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Whoa! What an amazing flower bed! The people taking care of it must really care about their work!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm already getting super excited! Let's go look around, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, I walk around the park with a very spirited Bamboo Memory.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh, this looks like the obstacle course! And the area in the back is just for Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: They've got a course where you jump from rope to rope till you reach the top of a hill, and another where you stand on a log and try to roll it around a pond! Sounds like fun!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hehe, this really brings back memories. My dad used to bring me to places like this back in the day!

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text: Look, Dad! I can jump all the way to that rope over there!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text: Nice going! You're the king of the jungle! Now wait up, I'm on my way!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Uaaaaah-uah-uaaahhh! ♪

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! That was amazing, Bamboo! I'm so proud of you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: (…Dad said I was amazing!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Um… hey, Trainer! I'm going to clear the whole obstacle course! Check me out!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yeeeaaah! How do like me now?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hehe, really?! Now, watch me clear the next one in no time flat too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory clears one challenge after another like she was born to swing!

text_block_list.name: Spectating Girl
text_block_list.text: Wow! Awesome! Look over there! She's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Spectating Boy
text_block_list.text: Holy cow! How does she move like that?! It's like she grew up swinging through the trees!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: …! Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: They haven't seen anything yet! Wait till you see me swing to the finish with just one hand!

text_block_list.name: Spectating Girl
text_block_list.text: Hey! What are you gonna do next?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Good question! Next… I think I'll try getting that log around the pond!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oh! What's up, Trainer? You think I should try something more difficult?
choice_data_list: If those kids try to imitate you, it could be dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: …Huh?!
Hey! That's not safe!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Um, excuse me, everyone! I'm sorry, but that's all for today!

text_block_list.name: Spectating Girl
text_block_list.text: Aw, really? …Well, thank you! It was really fun watching you!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I'm sorry. I got carried away again, huh?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: When you stopped me, it reminded me of something. My dad always gave me so much praise whenever I got excited, so I would always get so carried away, until…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Mother
text_block_list.text: Hey! What are you two doing?! That's dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Young Bamboo
text_block_list.text: Agh! Mom?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Father
text_block_list.text: S-sorry about that…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Then, we would always talk about what happened later as a family.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: When I think about it now, I really haven't changed at all… Ugh, I'm so immature!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I really need to take this more seriously and get myself under control!
choice_data_list: You should put that enthusiasm to good use.
You should put that enthusiasm to good use.
You just need to figure out the right moment to let loose.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I really need to take this more seriously and get myself under control!
choice_data_list: You should put that enthusiasm to good use.
You should put that enthusiasm to good use.
You just need to figure out the right moment to let loose.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It goes without saying that it's not good to be reckless, but passion is the energy that fuels Bamboo Memory. There's no reason to let it go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: …! You're right! Being passionate is who I am!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna keep on burning brightly without sweating the details!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's head back so I can finish off the rest of the obstacle c—
choice_data_list: Didn't we just agree that's too dangerous?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory is having a hard time finding the right balance between passion and recklessness… It seems she still has some growing to do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whether it's in racing, training, or working as part of the disciplinary committee, her passion will produce incredible results when the time is right.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! That makes it sound like I have to master my power!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: It's just like the training arc in a manga! I'm getting kinda fired up now!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trainer—no, Master! I'm going to work hard on mental discipline too, and I'll need your help!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory is bursting with enthusiasm. It looks like I'll need to keep an eye on her to make sure things don't get out of hand.
